objects.description: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061)'s malicious spearphishing payloads use WMI to launch malware and spawn `cmd.exe` execution. [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) has also used WMIC and the [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) suite for lateral movement, as well as during and post compromise cleanup activities.(Citation: FireEye Obfuscation June 2017)(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)(Citation: FireEye Know Your Enemy FIN8 Aug 2016)(Citation: Symantec FIN8 Jul 2023)
objects.description_fa: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) محموله‌های مخرب spearphishing از WMI برای راه‌اندازی بدافزار و ایجاد «cmd.exe» استفاده می‌کنند. [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) همچنین از WMIC و مجموعه [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) برای حرکت جانبی، و همچنین در حین و پس از پاکسازی استفاده کرده است. فعالیت‌ها.(Citation: FireEye Obfuscation June 2017)(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)(Citation: FireEye Know Your Enemy FIN8 Aug 2016)(Citation: Symantec FIN8 Jul 2023)
